name: Sole Searching

start.dialog: My sister Ruby - she runs the red stall in the Mire - she NEEDS these special sandals! Heat-resistant soles! Take them to her? Be careful - the path through Scorched Pass is rough on footwear!
start.objective: Deliver heat-resistant sandals to Shoewoman Ruby in the Mire

progress.dialog: Ruby should be at her stall near the bog edge! Tell her the new shipment is coming next week!
progress.objective: Travel to the Mire and find Shoewoman Ruby

complete.dialog: Sally sent these? About TIME! My feet were MELTING! Thanks, traveler! Here's something for your trouble - found these glowing stones in the bog. Pretty, right?

party_comments.kade: Sandals? Through the Scorched Pass? Better not melt them.
party_comments.renna: The craftsmanship on these is impressive. Heat-woven thread.
party_comments.twist: Can I get some cool shoes too?!

hidden_outcome: If you keep the sandals in perfect condition (avoid all fire damage on the way), Ruby gives you the 'Flame-Walker's Boots' instead of stones
